title: 24-Hour Sleep Architecture & Circadian Log Analysis
description: Track environmental light exposure, sleep onset, sleep stages, and cognitive alertness across a 24-hour cycle.
problemStatement:
Construct a hypothetical or real 24-hour circadian log detailing daily physiological oscillations.

### Requirements:
1. Map out light exposure times and explain how the Suprachiasmatic Nucleus (SCN) and pineal gland modulate melatonin release accordingly.
2. Model the typical 90-minute cycle progression across an 8-hour sleep period, showing the ratio of NREM-3 deep sleep to REM sleep from early night to morning.
3. Identify the consequences of blue-light exposure from screens within 60 minutes of bedtime on sleep latency and stage distribution.
hints: Hint 1: Blue-spectrum light mimics morning sunlight, tricking the SCN into suppressing melatonin.
Hint 2: Slow-wave sleep dominates early sleep cycles, while REM periods lengthen before morning awakening.
